subject: SOC 2 recertification: evidence intake, retention window & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@acmeinc.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Brown <matt.brown@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T16:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification planning & renewal

Hi Camila / Ben —

Thanks again for the QBR yesterday. As we discussed, Acme is targeting a formal recertification before our contract renewal window in Q4. Two asks from our side so we can lock internal approvals:

- Can you share a proposed evidence intake schedule and owner matrix (who on Redwood will accept each artifact)?
- We need options for log retention: standard (365 days) vs extended (730 days) — please call out the cost delta and any impact on SLA/throughput.

We are also planning to increase throughput for a seasonal product launch in Nov — likely +25% committed capacity and a 12-month term extension for better pricing. If you can include a rough MOP and a term amendment draft that would help.

I've attached our current audit scope spreadsheet and the internal audit calendar for visibility.

Sabrina
Sabrina Lowe
Head of IT Compliance, Acme Integrated Systems
sabrina.lowe@acmeinc.com
Attachment: Acme_Audit_Scope_2026.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T19:18:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification planning & renewal

Hi Sabrina —

Thanks for the clear asks. I've put together a short mutual action plan and intake checklist; see the attached MAPlan (high level). Key points up front:

- Evidence intake: Redwood will accept artifacts via a shared GDrive folder or secure SFTP. Karthik will be the intake owner for engineering artifacts; I will own attestation coordination and the legal term amendment. Ben will own commercial/seat changes.
- Retention options:
  * 365d (default): no SLA change, $0 additional per-seat; best for standard plans.
  * 730d (extended): adds +18% to storage/ingestion line items and may require a small throughput uplift for log export; we can include as an addendum to the renewal.
- Capacity uplift: for a committed +25% throughput uplift we can propose a 12-month reserved add-on at a 10% discount vs on-demand. Ben will provide a committed capacity quote by EOB Monday.
- Timeline: proposed evidence intake window opens Oct 4 — goal to complete artifact submission by Oct 22 to allow time for auditor review ahead of your November run.

Action items:
- (Acme) Drop evidence into shared Drive folder and tag artifacts with the MAPlan IDs in column A.
- (Redwood) Ben to send capacity quote; Karthik to confirm intake SFTP credentials by Sep 28.
- (Legal) I'll prepare a short term amendment + retention addendum and circulate for redlines by Oct 1.

Links:
- Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeEvidenceFolder
- Intake spreadsheet: (attached in MAPlan)

Attaching: RI_MAPlan_Acme_20260925.docx

Thanks — we'll coordinate a technical runthrough as Ben suggests.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. Manager, Customer Compliance & Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification planning & renewal

Sabrina —

Quick commercial note: if Acme commits to the 12-month term extension with the +25% reserved throughput, we can offer a blended discount (10% on the reserved add-on + a one-time renewal credit of $12k) that should offset the extended retention delta for the first year. I'll formalize the quote and include line-level pricing (storage delta, ingestion, egress) by Sep 28.

Also looping in Laura (legal lead) to fast-track the amendment review and DocuSign routing.

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical handoff on Sep 30 or Oct 1 (your preference) with our infra lead to validate artifact formats and the export window?

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@acmeinc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Brown <matt.brown@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recertification planning & renewal

Thanks all — that plan looks good.

We will:
- Start populating the Drive folder next week (tagging artifacts per the MAPlan). Our audit team will prioritize the auth/logging and user-provisioning artifacts first.
- Target Sep 30 for the technical runthrough (please send calendar invite). We prefer mornings EST.
- Matt (procurement) will need the DocuSign link and the redlined term amendment for internal approval; please route to matt.brown@acmeinc.com.

I'll upload our Internal Audit Calendar (attached) and a short note on the auditor expectations.

Sabrina
Attachment: Acme_Internal_Audit_Calendar_2026.pdf
